title: drymocallis glandulosa var. campanulata
intro: Drymocallis glandulosa var. campanulata, commonly known as Western Mountain Avens, is a plant species within the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Western Mountain Avens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory activities. Furthermore, Western Mountain Avens is also used in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues and as an antiseptic due to its ability to promote wound healing and reduce inflammation.
